    Source = #"p_schoolincome_s",
  #"Changed column type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Source, {{"id", Int64.Type}}),  
  
    #"Added TranType" =  
        Table.AddColumn(  
            #"Changed column type",  
            "tcbgrow_transtype",  
            each Int64.From(301220000)  
        ),
  #"Changed column type 1" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Added TranType", {{"tcbgrow_transtype", Int64.Type}}),  

    #"Added custom" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Table.AddColumn(#"Changed column type 1", "TranDescription", each [income_type] & "-" & [descriptions]), {{"TranDescription", type text}}),
  #"Duplicated column" = Table.DuplicateColumn(#"Added custom", "received_on_date", "tcbgrow_transactiondate"),

    #"Selected Columns" =  
        Table.SelectColumns(  
            #"Duplicated column",  
            {  
                "amount_received",  
                "received_on_date",  
                "TranDescription",  
                "school_id",  
                "id",
                "tcbgrow_transtype",
                "month",  
                "year",
                "source",
                "tcbgrow_transactiondate"  
            }  
        ),  
  


    #"Renamed Columns" =  
        Table.RenameColumns(#"Selected Columns", {{"amount_received", "tcbgrow_amount"}, {"received_on_date", "tcbgrow_asofdate"}, {"id", "tcbgrow_importincomeid"}, {"school_id", "tcbgrow_schoolid"}, {"month", "tcbgrow_month"}, {"source", "tcbgrow_source"}, {"TranDescription", "tcbgrow_description"}, {"tcbgrow_transtype", "tcbgrow_transactiontype"}, {"year", "tcbgrow_year"}}),
  #"Changed column type 2" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Renamed Columns", {{"tcbgrow_year", type text}})  
  
in  
    #"Changed column type 2";
